title: BrainrotBeGone
description: Stops "Lava Chicken" disk from assaulting your ears.
body:
# BrainrotBeGone

Prevents your ears from being assaulted by *Chicken Lava* by entirely stopping it from being played.

## Why?

Because it's the biggest and most blatant display of hypocrisy Mojang has ever shown.

Their long-standing excuse for not adding drops to friendly mobs has been that they "protect children" and don't want to depict animal abuse - fair enough.

Then they put a chicken in a trap in the movie and pour lava on it. You could argue, they outsourced the movie, no arguments or comments from them on the matter either. 

**And then they add a song about it to the game.**

This mod isn't useful, it's a protest against them repeatedly spitting into the face of Minecraft community. 

## How?
Just one client sided mixin.
